description: Look up one Mexican RFC in the SAT 69-B complete list (taxpayers presumed to invoice non-existent operations, EFOS). Returns whether it is listed and its situation (Presunto, Desvirtuado, Definitivo, Sentencia Favorable) with oficio numbers, publication dates, the data cut-off and the source citation. Lookup by RFC only; persona física names are never returned. Source: SAT open data (Libre Uso MX); not an official SAT service. Free: 20 calls per client per UTC day, shared by the Mexico tools (mx_sat_69b_lookup, mx_rfc_validate). When the free quota is used up the tool returns an error naming the paid HTTP endpoint https://mx.redtapeapi.com/v1/mx/sat/69b ($0.005 USDC per successful call over x402 on Base, no account or API key).

rfc.description: Mexican RFC, 12 (persona moral) or 13 (persona física) characters

name: mx_sat_69b_lookup
title: Mexico SAT 69-B (EFOS) lookup by RFC
